item.text: {"question_id":"4B.1","answer":"No. Formal electoral procedures were implemented: Parliament made endorsement forms available under constitutional and parliamentary rules, and the National Election Authority reported polling administration, judicial supervision, turnout, and an official 89.6% result (BATCH-0013-E006; BATCH-0018-E005). These procedures did not make presidential power genuinely contestable in practice. During the 2023 endorsement period, the number of notary offices fell from 389 in 2018 to 217; campaigners reported blocked access, assaults or intimidation, registration-system failures, ineffective complaint handling, and at least 140 arrests among Ahmed al-Tantawy’s campaign members and associates (BATCH-0008-E018; BATCH-0009-R03-E003; BATCH-0009-R03-E004). Authorities referred Tantawy, his campaign manager, and supporters for prosecution over election-related endorsement activity, while Amnesty reported at least 196 arrests or interrogations since 1 October and the prevention of genuine opposition candidates from running (BATCH-0007-E018; BATCH-0007-E019; BATCH-0019-E018; BATCH-0019-E019). Independent assessments concluded that these arrests, intimidation, and eligibility restrictions effectively eliminated meaningful competition; the 2019 constitutional amendments also extended Sisi’s term and enabled a third term (BATCH-0002-E001; BATCH-0002-E029; BATCH-0006-E014; BATCH-0006-E015). Sisi and election authorities denied or rejected allegations and described the election as free of violations, but those are official accounts rather than independent verification (BATCH-0018-E005; BATCH-0021-E013).","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0002-E001","BATCH-0002-E029","BATCH-0006-E014","BATCH-0006-E015","BATCH-0007-E018","BATCH-0007-E019","BATCH-0008-E018","BATCH-0009-R03-E003","BATCH-0009-R03-E004","BATCH-0019-E018","BATCH-0019-E019"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0013-E006","BATCH-0018-E005","BATCH-0021-E013"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The supplied evidence does not provide an independent full election audit or a court determination resolving every allegation about endorsement obstruction.","The evidence establishes conduct by state authorities and security or election bodies under Sisi, but does not establish that Sisi personally ordered each administrative obstruction or arrest.","The official result and administrative details are documented, but they do not independently establish meaningful contestability or acceptance of a verified opposition victory.","BATCH-0009-R03-E004's at-least-140 figure should not be read as necessarily including Tantawy's relatives because the excerpt does not clearly establish that inclusion."],"corrections_made":["Reduced the weight of formal procedures and official vote administration because they do not establish genuine contestability.","Added the omitted 2023 evidence on politically motivated arrests, intimidation, obstruction, and ineffective complaint handling.","Separated adverse findings about authorities under Sisi from proof of Sisi's personal authorization.","Preserved the official and presidential contrary accounts as qualified self-reported or state-affiliated evidence rather than treating them as independent validation."],"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":[]}
